name: Priemyselná automatizácia
description: Process of operating machines and other industrial equipment
author: Techdoc, 2026

words.definition: A system of connected components that uses pressurized fluid to transmit power and control movement.
words.example_en: The hydraulic circuit controls the movement of the machine's lifting arm.
words.example_sk: Hydraulický obvod riadi pohyb zdvíhacieho ramena stroja.

words.definition: The movement of a liquid, gas, or electricity in a steady and continuous way.
words.example_en: The engineer measured the water flow in the pipe.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zmeral prietok vody v potrubí.

words.definition: A motor powered by pressurized liquid, usually in a hydraulic system, that converts hydraulic energy into mechanical motion.
words.example_en: The excavator uses a hydromotor to drive the rotating mechanism.
words.example_sk: Bager používa hydromotor na pohon otáčacieho mechanizmu.

words.definition: A valve designed with a seat that controls the flow of liquid or gas by opening or closing against it.
words.example_en: The technician replaced the saddle valve to stop the leak.
words.example_sk: Technik vymenil sedlový ventil, aby zastavil únik.

words.definition: A liquid used in hydraulic systems to transmit power and enable movement or pressure.
words.example_en: The mechanic checked the hydraulic fluid before repairing the brake system.
words.example_sk: Mechanik skontroloval hydraulickú kvapalinu pred opravou brzdového systému.
